strings.notes: 昌平 not in 0719; US contact Schoolboy Ian (US 0703)

strings.zh: 你要是转到我班上的话,{CLEAR}我就要成班里的第２名了！{SCROLL}我要在这之前变得更强才行。{CLEAR}所以我们能交换电话号码吗？{SCROLL}这样我就能和你的精灵{NEWLINE}经常切磋切磋了！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hmm. If you transferred into my class,{NEWLINE}I’d become the second-best student{CLEAR}in my class, wouldn’t I?{SCROLL}I want to get stronger before that{NEWLINE}could happen, so would you trade phone{CLEAR}numbers with me?{SCROLL}Then we can have Pokémon{NEWLINE}battles together! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 等我做完下次对战的准备后{NEWLINE}会打电话联系你的！{SCROLL}你也要打电话给我哦！
strings.en: Cool. I’ll give you a call when I’m{NEWLINE}ready to battle again!{SCROLL}You can call me, too!

strings.zh: 难道你真的想{NEWLINE}转到我的学校里来？
strings.en: Wait...don’t tell me you’re serious{NEWLINE}about transferring into my school?!

strings.zh: 你要是转到我班上的话,{CLEAR}我就要成班级里的第２名了！{SCROLL}我要在这之前多和你较量较量,{CLEAR}使自己变得更加强大。{CLEAR}我们交换电话号码吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If you transferred into my{NEWLINE}class, I’d drop to second place!{SCROLL}Before that happens, I want to battle{NEWLINE}you more and get much stronger.{CLEAR}Let’s trade phone numbers!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 你陪我玩了这么久,{NEWLINE}我就送给你好东西吧！{CLEAR}请收下这个果实！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I want to give you something as thanks{NEWLINE}for battling with me!{CLEAR}Here you go--have a Berry!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？你在哪儿？{NEWLINE}难道就在附近？{SCROLL}要是你到了的话{NEWLINE}就直接来找我吧！
strings.en: Hm? Wait, where are you?{NEWLINE}I’m pretty sure you’re nearby.{SCROLL}If you’re going to come all the way over{NEWLINE}here, please feel free to approach me!

strings.zh: 我通过对你的战术进行参考后{CLEAR}和{VAR:0100:10}{CLEAR}进行了一场练习。{SCROLL}所以我现在才能有{NEWLINE}这么好的状态！{SCROLL}不过在我们变强的这段时间,{CLEAR}你们也一定变得更强了吧？{SCROLL}⋯⋯哎？那就是说,{NEWLINE}我们这辈子都无法战胜你了？
strings.en: You know, I’ve learned a lot from{NEWLINE}watching you battle, and I’ve been{CLEAR}practicing with my {VAR:0100:10}.{SCROLL}Thanks to you, we’ve improved a lot!{SCROLL}But even though we’ve grown stronger,{NEWLINE}you’ve probably gotten stronger at the{CLEAR}same time, I guess.{SCROLL}...Huh? So that means we’ll never beat{NEWLINE}you as long as we live?

strings.zh: 我通过对你的战术{NEWLINE}进行参考后{CLEAR}将{VAR:0100:11}打败了！{SCROLL}我的精灵也变得更强了！{SCROLL}下次见面后{NEWLINE}请再教我一些要领吧！
strings.en: I used the tips I learned from{NEWLINE}watching you battle to take down{CLEAR}a wild {VAR:0100:11} the other day!{SCROLL}Thanks to you, my{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s much stronger!{SCROLL}If we get the chance to meet again, I{NEWLINE}hope you’ll show me some more tricks!

strings.zh: 听我说！{SCROLL}前段时间,我还以为{NEWLINE}能抓到{VAR:0100:11}了,{SCROLL}结果就在最后一刻被它给跑了。{SCROLL}果然还是应该准备好{CLEAR}大量的精灵球才行啊。
strings.en: Hey, hey, listen up!{SCROLL}A few days ago, I was trying to catch a{NEWLINE}wild {VAR:0100:11}...{SCROLL}We went down to the wire, but it{NEWLINE}ended up getting away!{SCROLL}I really should have had a bunch of{NEWLINE}Poké Balls ready, I know...

strings.zh: 我在想,{NEWLINE}现在是不是能和你{CLEAR}再来一场对战了⋯⋯怎么样？{SCROLL}你做好准备了吗？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: You know, lately I’ve been wanting to{NEWLINE}battle you again... What do you say?{SCROLL}Are you interested?{NEWLINE}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 喂喂,我们约好了{NEWLINE}在{VAR:0104:3}对战的。{SCROLL}你可千万别忘了,{NEWLINE}快点来吧。
strings.en: Hello? Didn’t we make plans to meet on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} for a battle?{SCROLL}I’m sure you couldn’t have forgotten!{NEWLINE}Get a move on, already!

strings.zh: 你知道我为什么一直都{CLEAR}穿着短裤吗？{SCROLL}那是因为这样很帅！{SCROLL}磨伤膝盖,贴上创可贴,{CLEAR}只有穿短裤别人才看得见吧？{CLEAR}这样显得非常得狂野啊！
strings.en: Hey, you know why I’m always in shorts?{SCROLL}It’s because they’re really cool!{SCROLL}You know how, if you scuff your knees{NEWLINE}and you’re wearing shorts, everyone{CLEAR}can see all the bandages?{CLEAR}It makes me look wild and dangerous!
